name: Stock Image - Debian, other architectures (needs qemu-user on the host)
command: need=''; for p in sudo curl; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || need="$need $p"; done; if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add --no-cache sudo curl libgcc libstdc++ bash >/dev/null; elif [ -n "$need" ]; then if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends $need >/dev/null; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y -q $need >/dev/null; elif command -v microdnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then microdnf install -y $need >/dev/null; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum install -y -q $need >/dev/null; fi; fi; exec sleep infinity
